CustomField.description: Establishes a lookup relationship between Jewellery Product and Jewellery Category, allowing each jewellery product to be associated with a category for product organization, filtering, and display on the GoldVuee e-commerce website.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Select the jewellery category to which this product belongs, such as Rings, Necklaces, Earrings, Bangles, or Bracelets.
CustomField.label: Category
